newsitem.title: USA: PSE, AMEX set new options listings for next week.
newsitem.headline: PSE, AMEX set new options listings for next week.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Wednesday it would list options on Deltic Timber Corp on March 17 and the American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said it would list options on PathoGenesis Corp on March 18.
The PSE said Deltic options would open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35 and initial expirations in April, May, August and November. It said position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
Deltic Timber stock closed at 28-1/4 Wednesday, up 1/4.
The options have been allocated to pit representative Raymond Gin, the PSE said.
For PathoGenesis options, the AMEX said opening strike prices would be 30, 35 and 40, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. The stock fell 1-1/4 to 31 Wedensday.
Initial expirations have been set for April, May, June and September.
Highland Securities Co has been named specialist unit for the options, the AMEX said.
